stories.title: New HOFer Craig reveals dementia diagnosis
stories.summary: New Hall of Famer Roger Craig revealed during his taped acceptance speech Saturday that he has been diagnosed with vascular dementia.

stories.title: Raiders sit Cousins, Crosby day after scuffle
stories.summary: Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins and defensive end Maxx Crosby were held out of practice Saturday for disciplinary reasons stemming from their fight on Friday.

stories.title: Engelbert: WNBA to continue transgender talks
stories.summary: WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert sent a memo to teams that addresses ongoing discussions around transgender athletes in women's basketball.

stories.title: Ravens WR Flowers day-to-day after injury scare
stories.summary: Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers suffered a left quad contusion during training camp practice, avoiding a more concerning injury but still one that could sideline him briefly.

stories.title: Eagles RT Johnson: 2026 'probably my last year'
stories.summary: After rejoining the Eagles following four missed practices for personal reasons, right tackle Lane Johnson said he is likely entering his final NFL season.
